name: Database persistence (Prisma + PostgreSQL)
description: Adds a Prisma-managed PostgreSQL persistence layer to a stack pack that does not already ship one. Not for use with nextjs-postgres, which already includes this.

generatedArtifacts.description: Base datasource and generator block; the app's own models are added on top.
Prisma 7 CLI config — migrations path and datasource url sourced from DATABASE_URL.
Prisma client singleton wired to the @prisma/adapter-pg driver adapter.

verification.description: Confirms the schema and the database are in sync.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Prisma migrations under prisma/migrations/ give a repeatable, versioned persistence lifecycle, independent of which stack pack it is layered onto.
prisma migrate deploy is idempotent; every forward migration is expected to ship a hand-written rollback.sql alongside it, per the pattern in reference-apps/nextjs-postgres-crud.
